entities.name: Tuncay Özilhan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tuncay Özilhan is a Turkish businessman and billionaire. He is the current chairman of the board of Anadolu Group, as well as the president of Anadolu Efes. He was also the president of TÜSİAD from 2001 to 2004. He is also chairman of the board of supermarket chain Kipa.
